contexts.text: Deborah the nurse of Rebekah died () = that hereditary evil was driven out... Deborah as the nurse of Rebekah = hereditary evil. Explained... But here, Deborah the nurse of Rebekah = that which was received from the mother and nourished from infancy: this was the hereditary evil from the mother against which the Lord fought... and which He drove out.
This is why it is recorded in this verse that Deborah the nurse of Rebekah died and was buried under an oak.
She was buried beneath Bethel under an oak = that it was rejected for ever.
